title: HAR-RV vs Random Walk on 0050.TW 5-min RV (Taiwan ETF cross-market validation)

data_source.session: TW day session, regular trading 09:00-13:30 TW time
data_source.rv_formula: RV_t = sum_k r_5min,k^2 where r = log(P_t/P_{t-1}); drop first auction bar (volume==0)

methodology.model_alternative: HAR-RV (Corsi 2009): log(RV_t) = b0 + b_d*log(RV_{t-1}) + b_w*log(RV_w) + b_m*log(RV_m)
methodology.lag_convention: 1-step (Corsi 2009 + K1303 v2 ABD convention): features at t-1 predict log(RV_t)
methodology.dm_test: HAC Newey-West DM with HLN (Harvey 1997) small-sample correction, h=1
methodology.pass_rule: |DM_HLN_t| > 3 AND HAR-RV lower QLIKE (Harvey 2016 threshold). If n_test < 50 the verdict is reported as UNTRUSTWORTHY_SMALL_SAMPLE.

cross_market_motivation.tx1_finding: Standard HAR-RV is a near-sufficient statistic for TAIFEX TX1 daily RV; semivariance / jump / BMA all NULL once HAR-RV included.
cross_market_motivation.k1322_question: Does HAR-RV's predictive power over RW also hold on the 0050.TW spot ETF (different microstructure: lower liquidity, call-auction open, no after-hours)?

revisit_gate.rationale: 76-day intraday window after warm-up leaves n_test ~ 16. Re-run when n_total >= 200 (~ Aug 2026 if data collection continues).

DM_interpretation: positive t => HAR-RV lower QLIKE => HAR preferred; negative => RW preferred
caveats: n_test=17 < 50 → DM-HLN test under-powered; verdict is exploratory only. Revisit when n_total >= 200.
Negative OOS R^2 (HAR=-0.444, RW=-2.008) indicates test variance below sample-mean baseline — common with very short windows.
